columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Durable RunState resume preserves admitted input and execution evidence
columns.title_zh: 持久 RunState 恢复保留已接纳输入与执行证据
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Agents Python 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260810-G-004. It is the strongest bounded Digital Employee runtime question in today's pool: resumed work preserves pending input occurrence identity, exactly-once conversation tracking and local execution evidence instead of reconstructing state loosely. Skill 02 score: 46/50. The mechanism is directly relevant to work continuity, recovery, auditability and reconstructability.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260810-G-004。它是今天信号池中最强的有界数字员工运行问题：恢复后的工作继续保留 Pending Input 的 Occurrence Identity、Exactly-once Conversation Tracking 与本地执行证据，而不是松散重建状态。Skill 02 评分 46/50，直接涉及工作连续性、恢复、审计与可重建性。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the exact persisted RunState fields, occurrence identity semantics, shell-output preservation, serialization boundaries and failure cases without entering Research Analysis.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查实际持久化的 RunState 字段、Occurrence Identity 语义、Shell Output 保留、序列化边界与失败情形，不得提前进入 Research Analysis。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Multi-agent failure containment depends on trusted-state repair
columns.title_zh: 多 Agent 故障收敛依赖 Trusted-state Repair
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260810-R-003. It turns multi-agent reliability into a bounded architecture question by measuring cascade radius and recovery by failure mode, and by showing that blind retry can reproduce latent faults while apparent containment depends materially on a trusted-state signal. Skill 02 score: 46/50. This provides a concrete basis for recovery-governance and control-plane architecture decisions.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260810-R-003。它把多 Agent 可靠性收敛成可验证的架构问题：按 Failure Mode 测量 Cascade Radius 与 Recovery，并指出 Blind Retry 可能重现潜在故障，而表面上的 Containment 改善明显依赖 Trusted-state Signal。Skill 02 评分 46/50，可直接支持恢复治理与控制面架构判断。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the failure-injection design, cascade-radius and recovery metrics, blind-retry findings, trusted-state ablation, assumptions and external-validity limits.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查故障注入设计、Cascade Radius / Recovery 指标、Blind Retry 结论、Trusted-state 消融、前提与外部有效性边界。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Serialized and bounded MCP lifecycle operations prevent races and indefinite hangs
columns.title_zh: MCP 生命周期串行化与有界等待防止竞态和无限挂起
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Agents Python 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260810-G-003. The change exposes an implementable and testable lifecycle-governance pattern: connect, reconnect and cleanup share one lifecycle lock, cleanup survives cancellation, and finite waits/default timeouts bound failure recovery. Skill 02 score: 48/50. It is directly relevant to MCP reliability, recovery and worker liveness.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260810-G-003。该变更给出可实现、可测试的生命周期治理模式：Connect、Reconnect、Cleanup 共用一个 Lifecycle Lock，Cleanup 在取消后仍能完成，并通过有限等待与默认 Timeout 约束故障恢复。Skill 02 评分 48/50，直接关联 MCP 可靠性、恢复与 Worker 活性。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify lock scope, cancellation behavior, timeout defaults, overlapping-operation semantics, cleanup-worker lifecycle and remaining deadlock or leak boundaries.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 Lock Scope、取消行为、默认 Timeout、重叠操作语义、Cleanup Worker 生命周期以及剩余死锁或泄漏边界。
